# @zakkster/lite-rain v1.4.0

> Zero-GC SoA environmental rain engine. Z-depth parallax, streak physics, splash metamorphosis, bucketed rendering. One dependency.

## Install
npm i @zakkster/lite-rain

## Dependencies
@zakkster/lite-color (OKLCH -> CSS string conversion)

## Import
import { RainEngine } from '@zakkster/lite-rain';

## Key Facts
- 12 SoA arrays: x, y, vx, vy, z, gz, wz, bucket, radius, tailMult, life, state
- Precomputed per-drop: gz[]=gravity*z, wz[]=wind*z, tailMult[]=blur*z, bucket[]
- Two-phase lifecycle: streak (state=1) falls -> hits floor -> splash (state=2) fades
- Off-screen cull: a state-1 drop that leaves x<-200 || x>w+200 || y<-200 recycles to free (no upward/wind leak)
- Fail-closed door: non-finite config (gravity/wind/angle/...) throws at construction; non-finite/negative dt or dims is a no-op
- Z-depth parallax: every physics/render param scales by depth (0.2-1.0)
- 3 render buckets: one ctx.stroke() per depth tier (far/mid/near) -- batched drawing
- Terminal velocity clamping (depth-scaled)
- Responsive density: spawn count scales with canvas area
- Splash metamorphosis: streak -> splash with bounce, radius from impact velocity
- invSplashLifeMax computed once per frame (not per particle)
- Wind gust: vx += sin(_elapsed*gustRate)*gust*dt, computed once per frame at frame top (0 when gust:0); _elapsed advances unconditionally (determinism)
- Splash floor folded into one fy local: fy = floorY !== null ? floorY : h (default null = frame height h)
- splashDroplets (0..3): extra state-2 droplets per impact into free slots via the shared spawn ring; OFF path bit-identical
- ripples (strict bool): expanding ground rings in a pre-allocated 64-slot Float32 ring, aged/stroked in one path, allocated ONLY when ripples:true
- 12s age cap (MAX_FALL_LIFE) backs the off-screen cull: bounds the pool under any finite field
- RAIN_PRESETS export: frozen drizzle/steady/downpour/storm partial configs
- No clearRect -- rain is an overlay effect. Caller clears their scene first.
- spawn() and updateAndDraw() are separate calls -- caller controls spawn timing
- Pre-parsed OKLCH color in constructor
- RNG injectable, no lite-random dep
- No canvas ownership -- pure engine takes (ctx, dt, w, h)
- destroy() nulls 12 arrays

## API
- new RainEngine(maxParticles?, config?) -- maxParticles integer in [1, MAX_PARTICLES=2000000] (default 8000); non-finite force config throws RangeError naming the key; splashDroplets int [0,3]; ripples strict boolean; floorY finite-or-null
- .spawn(dt, w, h) -- spawn new drops (call every frame)
- .updateAndDraw(ctx, dt, w, h) -- physics + render (call every frame after spawn); does NOT clear the canvas
- .liveCount() -- O(max) count of live particles (state != 0); test/debug telemetry
- .clear() -- kill all particles
- .destroy() -- release all arrays
- export const VERSION, MAX_PARTICLES
- export const RAIN_PRESETS -- frozen partial configs: drizzle, steady, downpour, storm

## Config
gravity (1500), wind (200), density (5.0), maxSpeed (2500), blurStrength (0.04),
splashBounce (0.25), splashSpread (200), splashLifeMin (0.1), splashLifeMax (0.3),
splashScale (1.2), angle (null), gust (0), gustRate (fround(2*PI/3) ~3s period),
floorY (null), splashDroplets (0, int 0..3), ripples (false, strict bool),
color ('oklch(0.95 0.05 250)' | {l,c,h}), rng (Math.random)

## Presets (RAIN_PRESETS, frozen partial configs)
drizzle  { gravity: 900, wind: 80, density: 2, maxSpeed: 1500 }
steady   { gravity: 1500, wind: 200, density: 5 }
downpour { gravity: 2000, wind: 350, density: 14, splashSpread: 260 }
storm    { gravity: 2200, wind: 1200, angle: 0.4, gust: 300, density: 22, splashSpread: 320 }

## Game Loop Pattern
rain.spawn(dt, w, h);
ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);         // caller clears
drawScene();                       // caller draws scene
rain.updateAndDraw(ctx, dt, w, h); // rain overlays on top
